judgment.notes: The complete P binds an arbitrary complex module V, natural p, integer lam, arbitrary field K, complex-linear x,y,h, the specified v, and an arbitrary integer submodule M. H001 is prime p together with exact characteristic p, not merely p=0 in K; H002 retains both integer inequalities. H003 retains finite dimension lam+1, all three correctly oriented operator commutators, existence of a highest vector and complex irreducibility. These are the operator presentation of the source sl2 action: the Chevalley relations extend the triple to that action, and invariant subspaces agree in both directions because the generators span. H004 concerns the actual supplied v over C. H005 quantifies a common integer/complex basis and stability under every divided power, equivalent to stability under the unital generated integer algebra; it neither specifies the minimal lattice nor assumes a basis of the form b e_i. Such a basis is derived later. Tracing implementation helpers across each source cut gives R001 only H002/H003/H004, R002 only its H001/H002/H003/H005/N001 boundary, R003 its H001/H002/N001/N002 boundary, R004 its listed preceding outputs and allowed library facts, R005 H001/H002/N001/N002/N004, and R006 H003/N005/H001/H002. T005 is derived from H001. T004, T007, T009, T013 and T016 supply the internal N packages; all conditional T inputs have preceding producers and disappear on assembly. LatticeOps existence is constructed in T006 and carried by T007/T016, not added as an original H. Neither algebraic closure, positive lam, odd p nor irreducibility over K is assumed. The domains include lam=0 and p=2 and are not made empty by the definitions.
